## Solution

```java
class Solution {
    public int findContentChildren(int[] g, int[] s) {
        Arrays.sort(g);
        Arrays.sort(s);
        int i=0,j=0;
        while(i<g.length && j<s.length)
            if(s[j++] >= g[i]) i++;
        return i;
    }
}
```
